note: Draft register for Spec 057 (design D-19, PR #195 packet), opened 2026-10-21 under the runnable-experiments campaign plan the owner approved as written the same date (Part 2, member 14) and the portfolio triage of the same date, which found D-19 RIPE. Conventions as in Specs 032-046: requirement claims carry no falsification test where a gate or inspection is the operative check; boundaries carry the conditions under which each claim holds; evidence items carry observed_at from this draft because the cited facts were verified first-hand at drafting. The AEE lifecycle hooks have NOT run on this register; they are the freeze gate (tasks L4), and any recovery round they force changes claim text before any freeze digest is computed. ASM- ids name the assumptions each claim stands on: ASM-FIVE-SOURCE-SET (the five sources are exactly the canonical record plus its four recorded evidence instances), ASM-HELD-TEXT-IS-COPY (the held cleaned text is the program's working copy of the source document; the document itself, verified by its registry checksum, is the copy of last resort), ASM-HEADING-FORM (a heading is a structural object in the document, not any occurrence of its words), ASM-ACCOUNTING-IS-SUCCESS (the design's success is a complete accounting of the five, not a count of recoveries), ASM-RECOVERY-NOT-VERIFICATION (a recovered claim is created, not checked), ASM-VERBATIM (extracted text is the pinned bytes, with line-rejoining the only permitted normalisation), ASM-APPEND-ONLY (outcomes append; frozen records are never edited), ASM-LICENSE-UNCLEAR (all five registry records carry license_status 'unclear'; verbatim passage records are internal). FREEZE RECOVERY (2026-10-21): normalised to engine evidence values at 0.6-draft (kind observed, source_quality artifact; refs, descriptions, observed_at unchanged - the draft's free-form labels are not engine values); mutual independent_of declarations added on multi-item claims; freeze rulings DD-057-10 to DD-057-15 were carried into the boundaries of F057-C06, C07, C08, C10, C11, and C13 before the hooks ran. At 0.7-draft the 14 irreducibility-challenged claim texts (all except F057-C14) were restated as single head propositions with their carried clauses moved into the boundaries verbatim-in-substance (propositions, falsifiers, and verdict rules unchanged; F057-C14's text was not challenged and stands as drafted); boundary_confirmation records were added for the three negation-conflict pairs (F057-C04/C11, F057-C08/C11, F057-C09/C11) stating the shared boundary - record identity and lifecycle position - and that both members of each pair stand; and F057-C11's boundary now defines 'normal intake' by its observable product, answering the precision challenge on that claim. At 0.8-draft, final restatements of F057-C01, C03, and C08 cleared their remaining irreducibility challenges (single-proposition heads; the alternatives, the set enumeration, and the citation/locator enumeration carried in their boundaries), and F057-C11's head dropped the qualifier 'normal' - the intake is defined in its boundary by its observable product - clearing its precision challenge.
